scope: Asset files and catalog coverage only; no built website or device parity test.
ocr_note: OCR is a secondary check. Non-text textures and shapes produced candidate readings; these were assessed visually. An unwanted headset marking was removed in the final image. The genuine photograph was not altered to remove details of its original scene.
approval_note: Technical and visual checks do not establish user approval of new artwork, the final site palette, copy, token details, or an accessory concept.
